notes: Multnomah County cast vote record cvr-councilor-district-2.csv. Ballot allowed 6 ranks. Cleanup follows Portland City Code 2.08 (see data/portland/README.md). Ballots with an overvote: 988; with a skipped rank: 1029; with a repeated candidate: 632; remade ballots: 3598. Blank: 10441 with no marks (estimated from precinct styles), 475 with only overvoted ranks. 'Uncertified Write In' stands for all write-ins for people not on the City's certified write-in list, combined; the official count treats it as one candidate. Official winners from the final RCTab summary official/city-of-portland-councilor-district-2.json (Multnomah County Elections, certified December 2, 2024). Our first-choice totals differ from the official first round by 26 votes in all; see checks.json.
